Prices are per issue and confirmed in writing after a short brief. Payment is made using the M-Pesa or bank details published on the site. Thomas Hondo Chacha confirms payments manually. Automatic payment is coming soon; there is no auto-debit, payment gateway or pay-to-unlock flow.
